Title: 显示秒/星期
Description: 电脑右下角显示秒与星期
Data:
{"Script":"@echo off
::电脑右下角显示时间秒数
REG ADD "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v "ShowSecondsInSystemClock" /t "REG_DWORD" /d "1"
::电脑右下角显示星期几
reg add "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\International" /v "sLongDate" /d "yyyy'年'M'月'd'日', dddd" /t REG_SZ /f
reg add "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\International" /v "sShortDate" /d "yyyy/M/d/ddd" /t REG_SZ /f
taskkill /f /im explorer.exe
start %systemroot%\explorer","Type":"BAT","Ext":".bat","RunAsAdmin":false,"WaitForExit":false,"Encoding":null,"WorkingDir":""}
